# OPSP Strategy App

## Overview

The OPSP Strategy App is an interactive One-Page Strategic Plan builder that transforms traditional static strategic planning documents into dynamic, collaborative digital experiences. The application mirrors the Gravitas/7-Attributes template and converts each planning section into live, structured data with real-time updates and execution tracking.

The app serves as a comprehensive strategic planning platform that bridges the gap between high-level strategy formulation and tactical execution. It provides interactive OPSP canvases, priority tracking, metrics dashboards, team assessments, and SWOT analysis tools, all designed to keep strategic plans active and accountable rather than forgotten in folders.

**Current Status**: The application is fully connected to PostgreSQL database with complete CRUD operations for all entities. All data is persisted to the database - no mock or temporary data is used. The system includes:
- Edit Mode system with drag-and-drop card layout customization (roadmap_layouts table)
- Database-driven OPSP roadmap with full editing capabilities
- Priorities & Capabilities management with Executive Champion and Success Statement fields
- Rocks tracking with detailed fields (Executive Sponsor, Responsible, Accountable, Start Date, Project Management, BloomGrowth Visibility, Vision statements)
- One Year Goals with database persistence and Enter-key save functionality
- SWOT Analysis with database storage
- KPI Dashboard with add/edit/delete capabilities
- Agile Growth Checklist with 35 items across 7 Attributes, tracking individual user progress
- Real-time synchronization using React Query between management interfaces and display canvas
- Company ID: 200c32ef-28fe-4fa7-995d-96386671e89e (Small Giants)

## User Preferences

Preferred communication style: Simple, everyday language.

## System Architecture

**Frontend Architecture**
- React 18 with TypeScript for type-safe component development
- Vite as the build tool and development server for fast hot module replacement
- Wouter for lightweight client-side routing
- TanStack Query for server state management and caching
- Tailwind CSS with custom design system based on Material Design principles
- Radix UI components for accessible, headless UI primitives
- Shadcn/ui component library built on Radix for consistent design patterns

**Backend Architecture**
- Express.js server with TypeScript for API endpoints
- RESTful API design with `/api` prefix for all backend routes
- Session-based storage interface with in-memory implementation (MemStorage)
- Modular route registration system for scalable endpoint management
- Built-in error handling middleware with standardized error responses

**Data Management**
- Drizzle ORM for type-safe database operations and schema management
- PostgreSQL as the primary database (configured for Neon serverless)
- Shared schema definitions between client and server using Drizzle-Zod
- Database migrations managed through Drizzle Kit
- Structured data models for users, OPSP sections, priorities, metrics, and assessments

**Authentication & Authorization**
- Basic user schema with username/password authentication
- Role-based access control (Admin, Owner, Editor, Viewer, Coach)
- Session management preparation (connect-pg-simple integration ready)
- User context propagation throughout the application

**Component Architecture**
- Modular component design with clear separation of concerns
- Interactive cards for major features (Assessment, Priority Tracking, Metrics)
- Reusable UI components with consistent styling patterns
- Example components for development and testing purposes
- Dark/light mode theming support with CSS custom properties

**Design System**
- Small Giants branding with clean, minimal aesthetic
- Clean white base design with strategic coral (#EF3F56) color pops for CTAs and emphasis
- Teal (#4A5D62) reserved for text accents and secondary elements
- Typography scale using Inter font family
- Consistent spacing units (2, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16 Tailwind units)
- Card-based layouts with subtle hover and active state animations
- Light sidebar design with minimal visual weight
- Dark mode support with matching clean aesthetic
- Responsive design patterns optimized for strategic planning workflows
- Email authentication restricted to @smallgiantsonline.com domain only

**State Management**
- React Query for server state with optimistic updates
- React hooks for local component state management
- Context providers for theme and user preferences
- Form state management with React Hook Form integration

**Development Workflow**
- TypeScript for type safety across the full stack
- ESM module system throughout the application
- Development and production build configurations
- Hot module replacement for rapid development iteration

## External Dependencies

**Database & Infrastructure**
- Neon Database (serverless PostgreSQL) as the primary data store
- Drizzle ORM and Drizzle Kit for database operations and migrations
- WebSocket support through the `ws` package for real-time features

**UI & Design**
- Radix UI primitive components for accessibility and behavior
- Tailwind CSS for utility-first styling approach
- Lucide React for consistent iconography
- Recharts for data visualization and metrics dashboards
- Embla Carousel for interactive content presentation

**Development Tools**
- Vite with React plugin for fast development builds
- PostCSS with Autoprefixer for cross-browser CSS compatibility
- ESBuild for production bundling and optimization
- Replit-specific plugins for development environment integration

**Authentication & Session**
- Google Fonts (Inter) for typography
- Connect-pg-simple for PostgreSQL session storage (configured but not yet implemented)
- Planned OAuth integration for Google and Microsoft authentication

**Data Handling**
- React Hook Form with Hookform Resolvers for form validation
- Date-fns for date manipulation and formatting
- Class Variance Authority for consistent component styling patterns
- CLSX and Tailwind Merge for conditional CSS class management

**Quality & Performance**
- TypeScript compiler for type checking and build validation
- Custom query client configuration for optimized data fetching
- Error boundary and runtime error handling systems
- Trace mapping support for enhanced debugging capabilities

# Local Development Setup Guide

## Overview
This guide will help you set up the OPSP Strategy App for local development. The application uses PostgreSQL as its database and requires proper configuration to run.

## Prerequisites
- Node.js 20+ installed
- PostgreSQL database (local or cloud)
- npm or yarn package manager

## Database Setup Options

### Option 1: Local PostgreSQL Installation

#### macOS (using Homebrew)
```bash
# Install PostgreSQL
brew install postgresql@16

# Start PostgreSQL service
brew services start postgresql@16

# Create database
createdb opsp_builder

# Create user (optional)
psql opsp_builder
CREATE USER opsp_user WITH PASSWORD 'your_password';
GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON DATABASE opsp_builder TO opsp_user;
\q
```

#### Update .env file
```env
DATABASE_URL="postgresql://opsp_user:your_password@localhost:5432/opsp_builder"
```

### Option 2: Docker PostgreSQL
```bash
# Run PostgreSQL in Docker
docker run --name opsp-postgres \
  -e POSTGRES_DB=opsp_builder \
  -e POSTGRES_USER=opsp_user \
  -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=your_password \
  -p 5432:5432 \
  -d postgres:16

# Update .env file
DATABASE_URL="postgresql://opsp_user:your_password@localhost:5432/opsp_builder"
```

### Option 3: Cloud Database (Neon, Supabase, etc.)
1. Sign up for a cloud PostgreSQL service
2. Create a new database
3. Copy the connection string
4. Update .env file with the connection string

## Installation Steps

1. **Clone and navigate to the project**
   ```bash
   cd /Users/brennangerle/Desktop/Development/OPSP-Builder
   ```

2. **Install dependencies**
   ```bash
   npm install
   ```

3. **Configure environment variables**
   - Copy the provided .env file
   - Update DATABASE_URL with your database connection string
   - Optionally update other variables as needed

4. **Run database migrations**
   ```bash
   npm run db:push
   ```

5. **Start the development server**
   ```bash
   npm run dev
   ```

## Application Structure

- **Frontend**: React + TypeScript + Vite (port 5173)
- **Backend**: Express.js + TypeScript (port 5000)
- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Drizzle ORM
- **UI**: Tailwind CSS + Radix UI + Shadcn/ui

## Key Features

- Interactive OPSP canvas with real-time editing
- Priority and capability management
- Rocks tracking with detailed fields
- SWOT analysis
- KPI dashboard
- Agile Growth Checklist (35 items across 7 attributes)
- User authentication and role-based access

## Development Scripts

- `npm run dev` - Start development server
- `npm run build` - Build for production
- `npm run start` - Start production server
- `npm run check` - TypeScript type checking
- `npm run db:push` - Push database schema changes

## Troubleshooting

### Database Connection Issues
- Ensure PostgreSQL is running
- Verify DATABASE_URL in .env file
- Check firewall settings
- Verify database credentials

### Port Conflicts
- Backend runs on port 5000
- Frontend runs on port 5173
- Update PORT in .env if needed

### Dependencies Issues
- Delete node_modules and package-lock.json
- Run `npm install` again
- Check Node.js version compatibility

## Company Configuration

The application is pre-configured with Company ID: `200c32ef-28fe-4fa7-995d-96386671e89e` (Small Giants)

## Next Steps

1. Set up your database using one of the options above
2. Update the .env file with your database connection string
3. Run `npm run db:push` to create the database schema
4. Run `npm run dev` to start the application
5. Open http://localhost:5173 in your browser

## Support

If you encounter issues:
1. Check the console logs for error messages
2. Verify all environment variables are set correctly
3. Ensure PostgreSQL is running and accessible
4. Check that all dependencies are installed correctly

README.md.content:
# OPSP Strategy App

An interactive One-Page Strategic Plan builder that transforms traditional static strategic planning documents into dynamic, collaborative digital experiences.

## Quick Start

### Prerequisites
- Node.js 20+
- PostgreSQL database (local or cloud)
- Docker (optional, for easy database setup)

### Installation

1. **Clone and navigate to the project**
   ```bash
   cd /Users/brennangerle/Desktop/Development/OPSP-Builder
   ```

2. **Run the automated setup**
   ```bash
   npm run setup
   ```
   
   Or manually:
   ```bash
   npm install
   npm run db:start  # Start PostgreSQL with Docker
   npm run db:push   # Run database migrations
   npm run dev       # Start development server
   ```

3. **Open the application**
   - Frontend: http://localhost:5173
   - Backend API: http://localhost:5000

## Database Setup Options

### Option 1: Docker (Recommended)
```bash
npm run db:start    # Start PostgreSQL container
npm run db:stop     # Stop PostgreSQL container
npm run db:reset    # Reset database (removes all data)
```

### Option 2: Local PostgreSQL
Install PostgreSQL locally and update the `DATABASE_URL` in `.env` file.

### Option 3: Cloud Database
Use Neon, Supabase, or other cloud PostgreSQL services and update the `DATABASE_URL` in `.env` file.

## Available Scripts

- `npm run dev` - Start development server
- `npm run build` - Build for production
- `npm run start` - Start production server
- `npm run check` - TypeScript type checking
- `npm run db:push` - Push database schema changes
- `npm run setup` - Automated setup script
- `npm run db:start` - Start PostgreSQL with Docker
- `npm run db:stop` - Stop PostgreSQL container
- `npm run db:reset` - Reset database

## Project Structure

```
├── client/          # React frontend
├── server/          # Express.js backend
├── shared/          # Shared types and schemas
├── attached_assets/ # Project assets
├── .env             # Environment variables
├── docker-compose.yml # Database setup
└── setup.sh         # Automated setup script
```

## Key Features

- **Interactive OPSP Canvas**: Real-time editing of strategic plans
- **Priority Management**: Track priorities and capabilities with executive champions
- **Rocks Tracking**: Quarterly priorities with detailed project management fields
- **SWOT Analysis**: Strategic analysis tools
- **KPI Dashboard**: Metrics tracking and visualization
- **Agile Growth Checklist**: 35 items across 7 attributes
- **User Authentication**: Role-based access control
- **Real-time Sync**: React Query for data synchronization

## Technology Stack

- **Frontend**: React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI
- **Backend**: Express.js, TypeScript, Drizzle ORM
- **Database**: PostgreSQL
- **State Management**: TanStack Query (React Query)
- **Authentication**: Session-based with role management

## Configuration

The application is pre-configured with:
- Company ID: `200c32ef-28fe-4fa7-995d-96386671e89e` (Small Giants)
- Default database: `opsp_builder`
- Development ports: Frontend (5173), Backend (5000)

## Troubleshooting

### Database Connection Issues
- Ensure PostgreSQL is running
- Verify `DATABASE_URL` in `.env` file
- Check Docker container status: `docker ps`

### Port Conflicts
- Backend runs on port 5000
- Frontend runs on port 5173
- Update `PORT` in `.env` if needed

### TypeScript Errors
- Run `npm run check` to see type errors
- Some example components may have type issues but don't affect core functionality

## Development

The application uses:
- **TypeScript** for type safety
- **Drizzle ORM** for database operations
- **React Query** for server state management
- **Tailwind CSS** for styling
- **Radix UI** for accessible components

## Documentation

- `LOCAL_SETUP.md` - Detailed local development setup
- `replit.md` - Original project documentation
- `design_guidelines.md` - Design system guidelines

## Support

If you encounter issues:
1. Check the console logs for error messages
2. Verify all environment variables are set correctly
3. Ensure PostgreSQL is running and accessible
4. Check that all dependencies are installed correctly
5. Review the troubleshooting section above

#!/bin/bash

echo "🚀 Setting up OPSP Strategy App for local development..."

# Check if Node.js is installed
if ! command -v node &> /dev/null; then
    echo "❌ Node.js is not installed. Please install Node.js 20+ first."
    exit 1
fi

# Check if npm is installed
if ! command -v npm &> /dev/null; then
    echo "❌ npm is not installed. Please install npm first."
    exit 1
fi

echo "✅ Node.js and npm are installed"

# Install dependencies
echo "📦 Installing dependencies..."
npm install

if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "❌ Failed to install dependencies"
    exit 1
fi

echo "✅ Dependencies installed successfully"

# Check if Docker is available
if command -v docker &> /dev/null; then
    echo "🐳 Docker is available. Starting PostgreSQL container..."
    
    # Check if Docker daemon is running
    if docker info &> /dev/null; then
        # Start PostgreSQL with Docker Compose
        docker-compose up -d postgres
        
        if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "✅ PostgreSQL container started successfully"
            echo "⏳ Waiting for PostgreSQL to be ready..."
            sleep 5
            
            # Run database migrations
            echo "🗄️  Running database migrations..."
            npm run db:push
            
            if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
                echo "✅ Database migrations completed successfully"
            else
                echo "❌ Database migrations failed"
                echo "💡 Try running 'npm run db:push' manually after ensuring PostgreSQL is running"
            fi
        else
            echo "❌ Failed to start PostgreSQL container"
            echo "💡 You can start it manually with: docker-compose up -d postgres"
        fi
    else
        echo "⚠️  Docker daemon is not running"
        echo "💡 Please start Docker Desktop and run: docker-compose up -d postgres"
    fi
else
    echo "⚠️  Docker is not available"
    echo "💡 Please set up PostgreSQL manually or install Docker"
    echo "📖 See LOCAL_SETUP.md for detailed instructions"
fi

echo ""
echo "🎉 Setup completed!"
echo ""
echo "Next steps:"
echo "1. Ensure PostgreSQL is running (if not using Docker: docker-compose up -d postgres)"
echo "2. Start the development server: npm run dev"
echo "3. Open http://localhost:5173 in your browser"
echo ""
echo "📖 For detailed setup instructions, see LOCAL_SETUP.md"

# OPSP Strategy App Design Guidelines

## Design Approach
**System-Based Approach**: Using Material Design principles adapted for productivity tools, emphasizing clarity, efficiency, and data density while maintaining visual appeal for strategic planning workflows.

## Core Design Elements

### Color Palette
**Light Mode:**
- Primary: 224 71% 4% (Deep navy for headers, key elements)
- Secondary: 224 71% 8% (Slightly lighter for secondary text)
- Background: 0 0% 98% (Clean white background)
- Surface: 0 0% 96% (Cards and panels)
- Accent: 217 91% 60% (Bright blue for interactive elements)

**Dark Mode:**
- Primary: 224 71% 96% (Light text on dark)
- Secondary: 224 71% 88% (Secondary text)
- Background: 224 71% 4% (Dark navy background)
- Surface: 224 71% 8% (Elevated surfaces)
- Accent: 217 91% 70% (Brighter blue for dark mode)

### Typography
- **Primary Font**: Inter (Google Fonts)
- **Display Font**: Inter (weights: 400, 500, 600, 700)
- **Hierarchy**: text-xs through text-2xl, emphasis on readability in data-dense layouts

### Layout System
**Spacing Units**: Consistent use of 2, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16 Tailwind units
- Micro spacing: p-2, m-2 (form elements, buttons)
- Component spacing: p-4, m-4 (cards, sections)
- Layout spacing: p-8, m-8 (major sections, page margins)

### Component Library

**Navigation & Structure:**
- Fixed sidebar navigation with collapsible sections
- Breadcrumb navigation for deep hierarchies
- Tab-based section switching within OPSP canvas
- Floating action buttons for primary actions

**Data Display:**
- Card-based layout for OPSP sections
- Progressive disclosure for complex forms
- Inline editing with clear save/cancel states
- Drag-and-drop visual indicators
- Progress bars and completion indicators

**Interactive Elements:**
- Form controls with clear validation states
- Modal dialogs for complex workflows
- Tooltip system for contextual help
- Comment bubbles with @mention support

**Specialized Components:**
- SWOT matrix with quadrant visualization
- KPI dashboard with chart integration
- Assessment scoring interfaces (1-5 scale)
- PDF export preview overlay

### Key UX Principles

**Information Architecture:**
- One-page canvas as primary workspace
- Jump navigation between sections
- Contextual sidebars for detailed editing
- Clear visual hierarchy separating strategic vs operational data

**Interaction Patterns:**
- Click-to-edit functionality throughout
- Auto-save with visual confirmation
- Real-time collaboration indicators
- Version history accessible but non-intrusive

**Responsive Behavior:**
- Desktop-first design (primary use case)
- Tablet adaptation with preserved functionality
- Mobile view prioritizes viewing over editing

### Visual Treatments

**Data Visualization:**
- Clean, minimal charts using Chart.js
- Color coding for status indicators (red/yellow/green)
- Subtle animations for state changes only

**Content Organization:**
- Strategic sections use larger typography and spacing
- Tactical sections more compact for efficiency
- Clear section dividers and groupings
- Consistent iconography from Heroicons

This design system prioritizes clarity and functionality while maintaining visual appeal appropriate for executive-level strategic planning tools.
